title: How Much Does a Premium Silicone Companion Cost?

title: Partial Body vs Trunk — Which Should You Choose?
excerpt: A quick guide to compact realism: Partial Body Products versus Trunk models.
body: Partial Body Products cover focused forms — torsos, busts, and compact companions — ideal when storage space or travel matters.
Trunk models emphasize midsection realism and are often easier to pose and store than a full-size figure.

title: TPE vs Silicone: Materials Explained
excerpt: Feel, care, durability, and which material fits your priorities.
body: TPE offers a soft, warm skin feel and is often more flexible on budget Full Body and Partial Body models.
Platinum silicone is valued for longevity, heat resistance, and a firmer premium finish on studio companions.
Check each Intimauae listing for material and care notes so you know how to clean and store your purchase.

title: Caring for Your Companion After Delivery
excerpt: Simple cleaning and storage habits that keep materials looking their best.
body: Clean gently after use, dry thoroughly, and store flat away from direct sunlight and sharp objects.
Follow material-specific tips on the product page — TPE and silicone can need different powders or conditioners.
Keep original packaging if you may relocate; discreet cartons also help with private storage.
